data.one_liner: An implementation of the Time-based One-time Password (TOTP) algorithm.
data.what_it_does: Generates and validates Time-based One-time Passwords (TOTP) as specified in RFC 6238. Supports creating instances from raw code units or base32 encoded secrets, and checks remaining time.
use_when: You need to implement two-factor authentication (2FA) via TOTP in your Dart or Flutter application
You need to validate user-submitted time-based one-time passwords against a secret
avoid_when: You need a backend authentication provider rather than a raw token generation library
strengths: Supports base32 encoded secrets out of the box
Provides methods to generate, validate, and check remaining time for passwords
